zones.description: Vault-root-relative globs of sync zones (advisory; `wiki-sync scan <zone>` takes an explicit zone).

exclude.description: Vault-root-relative globs pruned from the walk. A NON-`.md` match is pruned immediately; a `.md` match is still read so a `#wiki/keep` tag can rescue it (precedence pinned in the loader).

profile.description: Distil profile → wiki-import `--kind`. `auto` (default): wiki-import prepare auto-detects the content-type. `meeting`/`lesson`: pyramid grammar (meeting-summary / lesson-summary). `article`: the article wrapper.

diagrams.description: Pass `--diagrams` (selective-mermaid overlay) to wiki-import. Default false.

extract_concepts.description: File concept pages (default true). false → `--no-concepts` (defer to /wiki-extract-concepts).

target_subdir.description: Optional subfolder under the topic folder where the summary note files (e.g. "_summary"). Default "" (the topic folder itself).

identity.description: Variant-grouping key: 'stem' (filename minus last extension — groups a .vtt with its same-stem .txt) or 'before-first-dot' (filename up to the first '.', for YouTube-id captions like ID.ru.txt / ID.ru-orig.vtt).

mode.description: if-missing (default): ingest only if no summary detected; if-changed: re-summarise iff the recorded source_state hash no longer matches the file (TASK 051); always; never.

source_state.description: D1 — a wiki-sync `source_state` hash marker counts as "summary exists".

fields.description: frontmatter keys checked (string or list value), e.g. [source, sources].

match.description: How a summary's cited `file:` is matched to a raw source (TASK 019/025). `vault-rel-path` (default): exact full-path equality — strict, only matches summaries that cite the raw by its vault-relative path. `basename`: basenames BOTH the cited value AND the raw target, so it matches summaries citing by basename OR by full path — preferred when source basenames are globally unique (e.g. YouTube-id transcripts) or an existing corpus already cites by basename; its only failure mode is two distinct raws sharing a basename across folders. The default is NOT basename (a default flip could merge such same-basename raws).

raw_dirs.description: dir names that anchor a raw tree (e.g. _raw, _transcripts, Transcripts).

summary_dir.description: sibling dir holding summaries; "." = the raw file's own folder.

group_key.description: shorthand regex applied to BOTH sides (default `^(\d+)`); superseded by `key`.

template.description: string.Template over named groups → the comparable key (e.g. ${module}-${lesson}).
